milestones.title: A House is Born
milestones.body: Founded in this year, marking the beginning of a captivating journey in fine fragrance, inspired by Malaysia’s blooming orchids.

milestones.title: Into the Department Store
milestones.body: Marking our retail expansion with an official presence in Parkson, bringing our fine fragrances to department store shoppers nationwide.

milestones.title: Taking Flight to the World
milestones.body: Debuted in travel retail with Valiram at KLIA Terminal 1, capturing the hearts of global travellers across Asia and beyond.

milestones.title: Expanding Beauty Retail
milestones.body: Partnered with SaSa Malaysia, establishing a nationwide presence to bring our signature scents closer to beauty enthusiasts everywhere.

milestones.title: Top Selling Brand
milestones.body: Achieved top selling brand status at Parkson, reflecting strong customer demand.

milestones.title: Soaring to New Heights
milestones.body: Partnered with AirAsia to take Legendary to the skies, quickly ranking among the top three best selling fragrance brands on board.

milestones.title: Expanding at KLIA2
milestones.body: Established our presence at KLIA Terminal 2, continuing to expand our reach in the global travel retail market.

milestones.title: Melaka Flagship
milestones.body: Opened our flagship doors on Jalan Hang Lekir, Melaka, breathing new life into a historic Peranakan shophouse through fine fragrance.

milestones.title: Cultural Revival and Expansion
milestones.body: Debuted our new counter in Genting Highlands while celebrating the release of the Nyonya Collection, weaving heritage notes into modern fine perfumery.

milestones.title: Heritage Beyond Retail
milestones.body: Debuted at the historic Bangunan Sultan Abdul Samad, extending the house beyond retail into iconic cultural spaces that celebrate Malaysian identity and storytelling.
